documentId.description: File-mode document id from openflow_open or openflow_create; omit to use the paired editor (or, in file mode, the document opened or created last).

id.description: Id for the new node; one is minted when omitted.

label.description: Text on the shape; required for catalog kinds other than the toolbar shapes.

pageId.description: Page to act on (see list_pages); defaults to the page the editor shows, or the first page in file mode.

x.description: Top-left x in page pixels (inside parentId: from the frame).

y.description: Top-left y in page pixels (inside parentId: from the frame).
